Conventions applied to every story: five-section description (Context / Problem, Approach, Scope, Testing, Acceptance Criteria) under the 8,000-character plan-review admission cap, mechanics moved to a first comment when needed; no uncertainty words; path:line cites on a named origin/main SHA; set_file_impact on every story; depends_on edges recorded. Cross-epic story dependencies are promoted by the tracker to epic-to-epic edges, so E9, E11, E12 and E10b show as blocked in ready/next-batch until the target epics close; the story-level intent is in comments. ADR numbers 0117, 0118, 0119 are placeholders because task arterial-bilineate-vampirebat (a01e-01e7-6e6e-4809) also targets 0117; each ADR story takes the next free number at landing.

Spec corrections made during ticketing: E10a's CI-parity counts derived from its per-test list (26 kept including the rewritten refspec test, 11 deleted; the spec summary said 23 and 14); E3 writes no ADR (0119 is E11-S3's consolidated record); E11's research rejected two brief items (docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md is the live process contract and stays; ADR 0029 is not superseded and gets a context-landed banner); E10a-S3 keeps the two mechanism-ratchet tests it would have deleted (entry 6).
